verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's marketing site describes built-in AI: agents that continuously monitor the product and surface insights, AI that spots trends across session replays, and AI summaries of replay playlists. There is no in-depth documentation of a user delegating arbitrary tasks to an in-product assistant. The hosted MCP server serves external AI assistants and is a different capability, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing an in-product assistant that users can hand tasks to, the scope of task delegation and actions it can take, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next.
